courses.title: SATYA 2 | Pumping the Prana | In-Person & Livestream Online Immersion
courses.description: The second five-day module of Tias Little's SATYA (Sensory Awareness Training for Yoga Attunement), held in Santa Fe and livestreamed. It goes into the shoulder girdle, SATYA with breath and pranayama, and how to sequence the gentle non-weight-bearing movements with asana for one's own practice and teaching, with dharma practice on working with the hindrances. SATYA 1 is required first.
